title: Cute Sweet Berries
description: Better-looking Sweet Berries with a more detailed and volumetric texture.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1d0383256bd3d90e103f72c7b3d1f829c06d073.png)

This resource pack improves the appearance of Sweet Berries in Minecraft by giving them a cleaner, fuller, and more detailed texture while still keeping the original vanilla style.

The berries look more vibrant and slightly more volumetric, making berry bushes feel much more natural and visually satisfying in forests, gardens, farms, and decorative builds. The new texture blends seamlessly with Minecraft’s art style while adding extra depth and polish to one of the game’s most overlooked plants.

Perfect for players who enjoy improving vanilla visuals without changing the overall feel of the game.
